metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the hunting query 'HUN - New Scheduled Task With Script Action'

properties.displayName: HUN - New Scheduled Task With Script Action
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where FileName in~ ("schtasks.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(schtasks.*\/create|Register-ScheduledTask|New-ScheduledTaskAction)"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell","cmd.exe","wscript","cscript","mshta","rundll32","regsvr32","-enc","FromBase64String","http://","https://")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hypothesis - schtasks.exe / Register-ScheduledTask creating a task that runs a script interpreter, encoded payload, or LOLBin is a top persistence TTP across ransomware affiliates.
